projects.title: IoT-Based Fire Monitoring & Cloud-Native Analytics Platform
projects.detailed_context: Production-grade cloud-native platform integrating IoT fire sensors with real-time analytics. Multi-cloud deployment across DigitalOcean Kubernetes Service (DOKS) and Azure AKS (East Asia region). Azure infrastructure uses OIDC-based Terraform with Entra ID auth, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) naming, Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault with CSI Secrets Store driver, VNet (10.0.0.0/16) with NSG whitelisting, and Azure Blob Storage for Terraform state. Infrastructure provisioned via 4-layer sequential Terraform pipeline: 00-bootstrap (Resource Groups, Storage), 01-infra (VNet, NSG, ACR, Key Vault, AKS cluster with Calico), 02-platform (Ingress-Nginx, cert-manager, CSI Secrets), 03-argocd (ArgoCD, Cloudflare Tunnel, App-of-Apps). Key technologies: Docker multi-stage builds, Kustomize (local/dev/prod overlays), ArgoCD (GitOps reconciliation), GitHub Actions (4-stage CI/CD with change-detection matrix, Trivy vulnerability scanning, kubeconform manifest validation, automated GitOps promotion), Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/Alloy/cAdvisor/Node-Exporter (full observability), PostgreSQL 16, InfluxDB 2.x (time-series via Flux queries), Redis (session/cache), Mosquitto MQTT broker, Telegraf (MQTT-to-InfluxDB bridge with json_v2 parsing), Flyway migration hook scripts, Nginx auth_request reverse proxy with Grafana role mapping (X-WEBAUTH-USER/X-WEBAUTH-ROLE), and microservice traffic isolation via Calico default-deny Kubernetes NetworkPolicies across 17+ manifests. Python ETL pipeline uses pandas for 5-minute normal data downsampling and 30-minute stateful anomaly debouncing with incident lifecycle management. Web dashboard features Leaflet.js geolocation maps, Chart.js sensor visualization, BFP (Bureau of Fire Protection) official incident report export, role-based access control (admin/responder/viewer) with approval gating, and Cloudflare Tunnel routing to dev.fires.systems / fires.systems. IoT simulator supports ESP32/MCU telemetry via TCP and WebSocket/TLS transports. 5-stage SDLC workflow via Makefile: rapid-dev (Docker Compose), local (Kind cluster), staging (ArgoCD to dev), production (ArgoCD to prod), Azure ops (Terraform plan/apply/destroy).

projects.title: Jobflow: AI-Powered ATS Resume Builder & Job Pipeline
projects.detailed_context: Full-stack AI-powered job application automation system. FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL 16 (12+ tables), SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, Alembic migrations, Pydantic validation schemas. Multi-platform web scrapers: LinkedIn (guest API + Playwright for browser-based scraping with cookie persistence), JobStreet/SEEK (httpx + SEEK Redux JSON decoding + cloud API), Kalibrr (Playwright + Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ extraction), Indeed (stub with PlatformBlockedError). Deduplication via source_url and external_job_id. 354+ jobs scraped (199 JobStreet, 89 LinkedIn, 66 Kalibrr). Gemini 3.6-flash & 2.0-flash LLM integration with structured JSON output (temperature 0.1) for JD requirement extraction (hard_skills, responsibilities, domain, seniority) and fact-anchored resume tailoring with strict no-hallucination boundaries. Match score algorithm tokenizing and cross-referencing candidate skills against job descriptions with percentage scoring. Interactive TailwindCSS+Jinja2+HTMX dashboard with Kanban-style pipeline (New/Approved/Applied/Skipped), split-pane AI resume editor, granular bullet customization with original/tailored comparison, live 1-page A4 print preview with pixel-accurate overflow detection. WeasyPrint ATS-compliant PDF export with strict typographic rules and python-docx DOCX export. Session-based authentication with itsdangerous and bcrypt. Human-in-the-loop approval workflow. SMTP email engine for application delivery with resume attachment. Master profile knowledge base with categorized skills, evidence linking, and bullet-point granularity.

projects.title: SandHub API: Clean Architecture C# REST Platform
projects.detailed_context: Enterprise REST API built with ASP.NET Core 8.0 Minimal APIs. Clean Architecture layers: Domain (entities, interfaces) → Application (CQRS commands/queries via MediatR, DTOs via Mapster) → Infrastructure (Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL/Npgsql, repositories) → API (endpoints, middleware, TokenAuthHandler).
